basic_details.job_title: GSSSB Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB), Gandhinagar, has invited applications for 6 posts of Food Safety Officer under Advt No. 466/202627. The online application is open from 27 October 2026 to 10 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online payment through Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallets. Last date to pay the fee: 13 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree in Chemistry OR degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agriculture Science, Veterinary Science, Bio-Chemistry, Microbiology or Medicine
qualification.details: Qualification: Master's Degree in Chemistry from a recognized university; Degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agriculture Science, Veterinary Science, Bio-Chemistry, Microbiology or Medicine Age limit: 18 to 37 years (as on 10 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/SEBC/EWS/Disabled As per rules | Other conditions: | Must be a citizen of India Possess adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both Basic knowledge of computer application is required

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 40,800 fixed per month for first 5 years

pattern_table.Subject: Constitution of India, Current Affairs, Gujarati & English Comprehension

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking of 1/4 mark for wrong answers Minimum qualifying standard is 40% for Part-A and 40% for Part-B

Fill in personal and educational details and upload photo and signature.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in Chemistry from a recognized university; Degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agriculture Science, Veterinary Science, Bio-Chemistry, Microbiology or Medicine Age limit: 18 to 37 years (as on 10 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/SEBC/EWS/Disabled As per rules Other conditions: Must be a citizen of India Possess adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both Basic knowledge of computer application is required

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GSSSB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons having any financial interest in the manufacture, import or sale of any article of food

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online payment through Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallets. Last date to pay the fee: 13 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will GSSSB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Competitive Written Examination (CBRT/OMR) Document Verification Competitive examination containing Part-A and Part-B Part-A consists of Analytical Tests, Data Interpretation, Quantitative Aptitude, Constitution of India, Current Affairs, Gujarati and English Comprehension Part-B consists of questions related to the relevant subject

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Negative marking of 1/4 mark for wrong answers Minimum qualifying standard is 40% for Part-A and 40% for Part-B

rows.subject: Constitution of India, Current Affairs, Gujarati & English Comprehension

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational certificates School leaving certificate Category certificate Disability certificate Computer knowledge certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSSSB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit OJAS website at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in. Complete OTR (One Time Registration) if not already registered. Click on Apply under Online Application for GSSSB. Fill in personal and educational details and upload photo and signature. Confirm application and generate confirmation number. Print application form and pay the exam fee online. Apply on or before 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Application fees will be refunded to candidates who appear for the examination

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GSSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 10 November 2026. Applications opened on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GSSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies for Food Safety Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GSSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/Reserved for exam fee: Rs. 400.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 37 years (as on 10 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/SEBC/EWS/Disabled As per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 40,800 fixed per month for first 5 years.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in Chemistry OR degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agriculture Science, Veterinary Science, Bio-Chemistry, Microbiology or Medicine.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India. Possess adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. Basic knowledge of computer application is required.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons having any financial interest in the manufacture, import or sale of any article of food.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Competitive Written Examination (CBRT/OMR). Document Verification. Competitive examination containing Part-A and Part-B. Part-A consists of Analytical Tests, Data Interpretation, Quantitative Aptitude, Constitution of India, Current Affairs, Gujarati and English Comprehension.
